description: Acceptance checks for any marketing asset featuring Mona Ataya. Machine checks run first via scripts/eval_runner.py (deterministic, regex and string based). LLM checks run second (judged by the reviewing agent). Any failed hard check is a hard stop returning to the author with the failing item and required fix. Then arabic-copy-qa, then brand-qa-reviewer, then the human gate. Checks marked applies_to=assets run only on generated marketing assets; governance docs (fact files, libraries documenting blocked claims) are checked with --docs.

machine_checks.fix: Replace em dash with comma, colon, or period
Replace en dash with 'to' or a hyphen in ranges
Unverified figure (claims row 4): use 'over 50 million' / 'أكثر من 50 مليون'
Unverified detail (claims row 6): use '3 children' / '3 أطفال'
Unverified stat (claims row 11): hold until confirmed
Disputed stat (claims row 12): does not run as stated; source a verified stat instead
Never imply accreditation; certificates are completion certificates

llm_checks.rule: If the asset is public-facing, the catalog public status for mona-ataya must be 'launched'. Currently 'unconfirmed': public assets are blocked, internal drafts carry a 'blocked on status' flag.

Every factual claim about Mona Ataya, Mumzworld, Bayt.com, or Pharmacity matches a claims-table row marked 'verified' and stays within what the source supports. Pharmacity (row 20) is single-source: do not use until confirmed.
Class title, lesson list, launch dates, and playlist themes appear only as recorded in the fact file or the brief. Themes come from the confirmed playlist list.
Copy promises learning and tools, never outcomes: no implied funding success, acquisition, or guaranteed results.
Until the register policy is decided: new copy is Gulf-familiar MSA (or brand-tone English). Levantine colloquial only in quoted source reference.
Tone matches voice.md: empathy before instruction, empowering framing, no fear-mongering, motherhood never framed as limitation, no get-rich-quick framing.
Arabic name spelled as in the catalog pending official-asset confirmation; EN as 'Mona Ataya'.

golden_examples.label: pass
golden_examples.text: بنيتُ شركة وجمعت أكثر من 50 مليون دولار وأنا أربي 3 أطفال. في هذا الصف أشارككم كيف فعلتها.
golden_examples.why: Verified claims (rows 3, 5), MSA register, learning promise, house style.

golden_examples.label: fail
golden_examples.text: جمعت 60 مليون دولار ورح علمكن تنجحوا أكيد.
golden_examples.why: Unverified 60M (machine check blocked-claim-60m), colloquial register, guaranteed-outcome promise.
